text.en: Even in drought, a mother's love never dries up.

This short story by S. Samuthiram shows humanity (மனிதம்) through motherhood. All kinds of literature speak about humanity, and Tamil short stories do too. The story says that whatever may dry up, human kindness must not.
Through the story, motherhood becomes the way in which humanity is protected. It teaches that love and care for others do not depend on wealth.
Terms: தாய்மை (motherhood), வறட்சி (drought), மனிதம் (humanity) and சிறுகதை (short story).

problem.en: Say in your own words what 'Thaimaikku Varatchi Illai (தாய்மைக்கு வறட்சி இல்லை!)' is about.

prompt.en: A friend says The story is about a farmer's loss only. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: It is about motherhood and humanity.
